scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @medledger/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @medledger/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @medledger/backend && npm run build --workspace @medledger/frontend && npm run build --workspace @medledger/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @medledger/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @medledger/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @medledger/contracts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @medledger/backend && npm run test --workspace @medledger/frontend && npm run test --workspace @medledger/contracts
